training_sampling.note: A deterministic 200-row cycle makes the 62.4k, 125k, 250k, 500k, and 1M training prefixes identically distributed. Target-tail labels are sampled by physical root then converted to admissible controls. Transport-path rows are recurrence-derived inlet, retreat, stationary, and flux-correlated states.

validation.selection: Use the fixed independent validation set for early stopping; report per-decade and per-design test panels separately.

network_candidate.input_normalization: [-1,1] affine; beta_max=1000000 is serialized as this artifact's package input_max, not a CRIS constant
